title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
statement_md: Maximize profit with cooldown: after selling, cannot buy on next day.
hints: Use three states: holding, sold, reset.
editorial_md:
### Method: State Machine DP
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(1)$
